_note: 페이지 표기 기반 검수 분류. 국내 법적 지위·수입·판매 허가 판정 아님. 도메인 검토 2026-11-19 반영; 기존 ID 유지.

instructions.product_type: Classify the product's visible presentation for screening, not its legal status in Korea. Use the supplied product name, label headings, ingredient text, directions and claims. Lack of Korean approval wording does not make an overseas supplement ordinary food. Choose drug_suspect for explicit medicine or disease-treatment signals; do not infer an unlisted drug ingredient. Otherwise distinguish supplement presentation from conventional food, and choose unknown when evidence is insufficient or conflicting. No choice establishes Korean approval, import eligibility or permission to sell.
instructions.form: What is the dosage form of this product?
instructions.use: What is the main intended use of this product?

general_food.label: 일반식품 표기
general_food.criteria: Presented as a conventional food or beverage for ordinary eating or drinking, rather than as a dietary supplement or medicine. Missing Korean approval wording or a missing Supplement Facts panel alone is not evidence for this choice.

health_functional.label: 해외 영양보충제 표기
health_functional.criteria: An ingested product explicitly presented as a dietary, vitamin, mineral or herbal supplement, or bearing Supplement Facts. Dosage form and nutrient content alone are insufficient. This describes overseas labeling, not Korean health functional food approval. Explicit medicine or disease-treatment signals require drug_suspect review.

drug_suspect.label: 의약품 관련 표시·성분 확인 필요
drug_suspect.criteria: Explicit medicine labeling such as Drug Facts, an identified pharmaceutical active ingredient supported by the supplied evidence, or an affirmative disease-treatment or prevention claim requires review. A disclaimer saying not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent disease is not such a claim. Do not infer T4 or levothyroxine from Thyroid (Bovine), or drug content from dose, organ name or intended use alone.

quasi_drug.label: 위생용품 등 표기·분류 확인 필요
quasi_drug.criteria: Presented as a non-food oral-care or hygiene product without a clearer medicine signal. This is screening only; Korean quasi-drug status is not established. Explicit medicine or disease-treatment signals take precedence.

cosmetic.label: 화장품 용도 표기
cosmetic.criteria: Presented for cleansing, beautifying or conditioning skin or hair, rather than ingestion or disease treatment. Topical use alone does not establish cosmetic status; explicit medicine signals require review.

unknown.label: 표기만으로 판단 어려움
unknown.criteria: The supplied evidence is missing or conflicting and does not support one of the screening categories. Missing Korean approval alone does not make a clearly labeled overseas supplement unknown.

general.label: 일반 영양
general.criteria: General nutrition such as vitamins or minerals.

check_sets.label: 자가사용·통관 안내
check_sets.text: 해외 영양보충제 표기를 확인했습니다. 국내 건강기능식품 인정이나 통관·판매 가능을 뜻하지 않습니다. 실제 수입 유형과 자가사용·신고 요건은 별도로 확인해야 합니다.
